title: 61--Purchase valve actuators
description: This is a Sources Sought announcement for acquisition planning purposes and no formal solicitation for this requirement exists at this time. All businesses, regardless of size; capable of providing these services, are invited to respond to this announcement and submit a capability statement for consideration. Capability statements received will be reviewed to determine a firm's previous experience performing similar work and used to determine an appropriate procurement strategy, in particular, whether a small business set-aside is warranted or an alternate procurement strategy. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this notice or otherwise pay for information solicited. Proposed Project: The Bureau of Reclamation (Reclamation), Lower Colorado Basin, Hoover Dam, has a requirement to purchase eight (8) valve actuators to use for the bypass system. The valve actuator's specifications are as follows: -Electric on/off actuator that can be operated remotely -Actuator must be compatible with a 12-inch A-T Controls Power-Seal Hp 300# Lug Butterfly Valve -Actuator enclosure must be dust tight and waterproof to a depth of at least 40 feet -Actuator must be suited for a maximum torque load of 17500 in-lbs -Motor uses 480VAC/3PH (three phase AC power) -Control uses 110VAC/1PH (single phase AC power) -Ensure the valve is still able to be operated manually with a bare stem operator when the actuator is installed -The selected actuators must comply with the Buy American Act (BAA), including all components used in the actuator assembly. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code 333995, Fluid Power Cylinder and Actuator Manufacturing with a corresponding small business size standard of 800 Employees. Interested firms are requested to submit the following information: 1.Name and address of Firm 2.Phone number 3.Email Address 4.Unique Entity ID (formerly DUNS Number) 5.Size status/SBA certifications (Small business, Women Owned Small Business, HUBZone, Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business, other) 6.Capability Statement (not to exceed 5 pages). A brief summary of capabilities to include demonstration of the firm's capability to provide a product that meets the specifications and include place of manufacture. All responses must be submitted via email no later than 2:00 P.M., Pacific Time, August 27, 2026. Email address: diane_rodriguez@ios-doi.gov. Include the reference number (DOIRFBO26013) in the subject line. All questions concerning the sources sought announcement should be directed to Diane Rodriguez by email at diane_rodriguez@ios.doi.gov. No phone calls please. When it is determined that a formal solicitation will be issued, the pre-solicitation notice will be posted on Contract Opportunities at sam.gov web site at http://sam.gov/.

title: H-1 Structural and Power Improvements for Next-Gen Effects (SPINE) 3.0 Security Requirements / Delta PRR
description: The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) Patuxent River, MD intends to issue a Firm Fixed Price (FFP) modification to contract N0001926C0140 to Bell Textron Inc., 3255 Bell Flight Blvd, Fort Worth, Texas 76118. This modification includes tasks for security requirements and Delta Production Readiness Review (PRR) for sub-system configuration components specific to electrical items for both AH-1Z and UH-1Y and to structural items for UH-1Y, in support of the Structural and Power Improvements for Next-Gen Effects (SPINE) Phase III effort. This requirement will be procured in accordance with the statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition under 10 U.S.C.3204(a)(1), as implemented by the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 6.103-1. Although the Government possesses unlimited data rights in the SIEPU Technical Data Package, it does not possess the requisite license rights in the Bell Process Specifications and Bell Standards necessary to compete the efforts anticipated. The estimated timeframe to qualify another source and develop the technical data for the requirements herein is eight (8) years based on historical UH-1Y/AH-1Z Upgrades data and, as such, an award to another source would result in an unacceptable delay in providing the supplies and services. Therefore, NAVAIR has determined Bell is the only responsible source capable of meeting the agency�s requirements. This notice is for information purposes only. title: R--FRST - OPERATIONAL AND SECURITY UPGRADES
description: EO 14398 FRST - OPERATIONAL AND SECURITY UPGRADES The National Park Service, Region 2, South Atlantic Gulf, intends to award a Firm Fixed price contract for Operational and Security Upgrades for First State National Historical Park located in Wilmington Delaware. This project provides complete network infrastructure installation with new network switches for a 3,000 sq ft, two-story office-converted building, with structured cabling extended to two outbuildings. The installation includes a total of 47 data drops: 20 dual-port wall jacks (40 drops), 2 dual-port outbuilding jacks (4 drops), 2 ceiling-mounted WAP jacks (2 drops), and a single cable demarc extension. Installation includes two switches with SFP fiber connectivity between them. All work complies with DOI standards, NEC, TIA/EIA-568, and NPS Cabling Standard v1.4 Final/Rev2 and all network hardware is compliant with NDAA Section 889 and Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 52.225-5 (The Trade Agreements Act (TAA). Additionally, there are three related systems that are included in the project: � Installation of underground conduit between office and two outbuildings. � Security Camera System � Security Door This requirement is being procured in accordance with FAR Part 6.302-1, only one responsible source. The determination to select Colossal Contracting LLC. is the only entity with knowledge of the current system and capabilities with current equipment that the park intends to integrate into the new system. They have previous knowledge of the current system. It is advantageous to the NPS to have work with the same contractor that provided the original system to ensure compatibility with the new system along with making sure all regulations and compliance are met. Additioanlly, the system will be fed into our Law enforcement systems which will require a level of security and knowledge with current county regulations and system compatibility. Lastly, it is in the best interest of the Government to utilize this contractor to decrease potential costs on the overall project by saving on unnecessary manpower for re-accomplishing work that has already been accomplished. NAICS Code: 334290, Other communications Equipment Manufacturing, Standard business size is 800. The National Park Service is presently using SAM/FBO to issue synopsis for Notice of Intent to Award Sole Source Justifications and Sources Sought. The synopsis may be viewed online at: https://beta.sam.gov. FBO will be the only means of obtaining the amendments and will be able to receive electronic notification of solicitations and awards. CAUTION: This synopsis will be issued electronically as will any amendments. The Government is under no obligation to maintain a bidder's list. It is incumbent for any interested parties to obtain any amendments which may be issued. All questions pertaining to the synopsis can be directed to celinda_hicks@ios.doi.gov or by calling 470-819-0814. This is a sources sought for interested vendors for this project. A solicitation will not be released for this requirement. This will be a notice of intent to award on a sole source basis to Colossal Contracting LLC.

title: 42--NFES 001094 PRY AXE
description: The Department of the Interior, Fire and Aviation Directorate/National Interagency Fire Center (NIFC), intends to negotiate with only one source, Paratech, for (250) Pry Axes and Sheaths. This action is authorized by and in accordance with FAR 6.302.1. The Government believes that the only responsible source capable of satisfying the agency's requirement is Paratech. A Justification for Other than Full and Open Competition has been prepared in support of this acquisition and is available upon request. The Paratech Pry Axe with standard claw (part number22-000520) meets the specifications to fit inside the nationally stocked crash rescue kit used by all fire caches and field rescue personnel. The tool has been used in the field during fire suppression and rescue operations with no failures reported. Using this particular tool allows all national fire caches to have standard kit components as well as facilitate standard training and familiarity for the end user in times of emergency operations. The Great Basin Cache currently carries refurbishment parts for only the Paratech Pry Axe. It would be counterproductive and require additional parts and training to carry a different brand. The parts in the national kits would not be interchangeable. Any alternative pry axe would require certification from the Forest Service Technology centers as approved for fire operations. The estimated value of this acquisition is $150,750. No Request for Quotation (RFQ) will be issued, and no response will be made to letters or telephone requests for a copy of the solicitation. This is not a request for competitive quotes, but serves as a procurement notice to fulfill public posting requirements in accordance with FAR 5.101(a)(1). The requirement is unrestricted and the NAICS code 333998-13 applies. Responsible firms believing they can provide the required items are encouraged to identify themselves and give written notification to the Contracting Officer by August 27th, 2026 at 5pm Eastern referencing action 140L3726Q0159. However, they must provide convicting evidence that they can furnish the requested items at a cost that will not exceed the total estimated transaction cost. All responses will be fully considered. If no affirmative responses are received by 5pm Eastern on August 27th, 2026 to the effect that a comparable source exists, an order will be placed with Paratech for the requirement stated here. Questions concerning this acquisition may be directed to Contracting Officer, Casey Gean Boyd at casey_boyd@ios.doi.gov.

description: This is a Sources Sought Notice. This notice is for informational purposes only and does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quotation (RFQ), or a promise to issue solicitation. The U.S. Government is conducting market research to identify qualified sources capable of rapidly producing the Family of Counter-UAS Systems (FoCUS) hardware. title: RFI: Targetry Range Automated Control and Recording II (TRACR II) Software
description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION SUBJECT: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION REGARDING RANGE CONNECTIVITY PURPOSE: Product Manager Tactical Training System (PdM TTS) is requesting information from interested offerors regarding a technical challenge regarding data transfer between two networks. BACKGROUND: PdM TTS is responsible for supporting ranges that utilize the Targetry Range Automated Control and Recording II (TRACR II) software. This software is responsible for operating range targetry and collecting scoring data. The current Authority To Operate (ATO) that exists on these ranges prohibits external connections and the system operates fully independent of any external communications to any network. Successful transfer of this data from the existing closed network to a separate, cloud-based database requires operators to manually record data into logbooks and then re-enter it on a separate computer network. Note: data is unclassified. REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (Technical): PDM TTS is requesting information on the most efficient way for this data to be successfully transferred between these two networks. Data transfer can be either uni-directional or bi-directional between the networks. Points to consider when creating a solution should include what type of data would be sent, what modifications would be required to the existing hardware and software configuration, how this solution would be implemented, utilized, and documented, and what impacts this solution would have on the existing ATO. COMPANY PROFILE: To assist the Government in determining if this can be set aside for small businesses, please provide the following administrative information: � Company Name, CAGE Code, and UEI Number. � Point of Contact (Name, Phone, Email). � Business Size Standard and Socio-Economic Status (e.g., Small Business, 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB) under NAICS Code: 541512 for Computer Systems Design or 541511 for Custom Computer Programming). � A brief summary of your company�s experience implementing similar cross-network data transfer solutions in DoD or highly regulated environments. title: Turner Roof and Building Envelope Project
description: The U.S. General Services Administration intends to solicit construction services for the Turner Roof & Building Envelope Project at the Turner Land Port of Entry, 41725 Turner Road, Turner, Montana 59542, Building No. MT0055AW. The project includes roof replacement and building envelope improvements at the main building, including work on the U.S. and Canadian sides of the facility, and envelope improvements at the water treatment building. Work includes, but is not limited to, selective demolition, roof replacement, exterior wall/cladding repairs, thermal and moisture protection, metals, openings, finishes, and incidental electrical, communications, and security-related coordination. The facility will remain occupied and operational during construction. The contractor must phase and secure the work daily, maintain safe access, protect ongoing border operations, and coordinate with GSA, CBP, CBSA, and other stakeholders regarding antennas, cameras, cables, signs, access, security, and inspections. Work affecting the Canadian side may require Canadian access, work permit, and material import coordination. Certain roofing materials may be furnished through the existing roofing warranty process; the contractor will be responsible for coordinating those materials with the manufacturer/certified installer and providing all remaining labor, materials, equipment, supervision, bonds, permits, and incidentals required to complete the work. The contractor shall comply with the solicitation documents, drawings, specifications, applicable codes and standards, GSA PBS Core Building Standards, security and badging requirements, environmental survey requirements, fire/life safety requirements, submittal requirements, and closeout requirements. The anticipated period of performance is 150 calendar days after notice to proceed. The solicitation is expected to include base bid work for the main building roof and envelope on the U.S. side, main building roof and envelope on the Canadian side, and water treatment building envelope work on the U.S. side. An in-person site visit is anticipated. Currently the date is TBD.

title: Denmark – Sewage, refuse, cleaning and environmental services – Offentligt udbud på transport og behandling af A2-træ for Ressourcer & Genbrug – Vejle Kommune
description: Udbudsprocessen omfatter en kontrakt til Ordregivers anskaffelse af transport og behandling af A2-træ til genanvendelse fra Vejle Kommunes genbrugspladser. Tilbudsgiver skal forestå afhentning, transport, behandling og genanvendelse af det indsamlede A2-træ fra Ordregivers fire (4) genbrugspladser samt stille nødvendige containere til rådighed på RessourceCenter Vejle i hele kontraktperioden. Tilbudsgiver skal sikre, at størst mulig andel af træet genanvendes, og at restprodukter håndteres i overensstemmelse med gældende lovgivning, herunder affaldsbekendtgørelsen. I 2025 var mængden for træ til genanvendelse (A2-træ) å 6.462 tons og antallet af afhentninger for et læs á to (2) fyldte containere på 716 fra Ordregivers fire (4) genbrugspladser. Mængden og antal afhentninger af træ til genanvendelse (A2-træ) forventes at variere hen over året samt mellem de enkelte år i kontraktperioden. Det forventes, at de fremtidige mængder og antal afhentninger vil ligge på omtrent samme niveau. Den forventede volumen i tilbudslisten er alene vejledende og ikke bindende for Ordregiver, da de baserer sig på historiske tal. Der henvises i øvrigt til udbudsmaterialet for en nærmere beskrivelse af den udbudte opgave.

Mit dem Vergabeverfahren strebt der ZRF eine Innovationspartnerschaft (§ 19 VgV) zur gemeinsamen Entwicklung und den späteren Erwerb eines innovativen Einsatzleitsystems für die Integrierte Leitstelle Saarland an. Das neue Einsatzleitsystem soll die bewährten Kernfunktionen eines marktüblichen Einsatzleitsystems zuverlässig abbilden und zugleich innovative Bestandteile enthalten, die im Rahmen einer Innovationspartnerschaft gemeinsam mit dem Auftragnehmer entwickelt, erprobt und in den produktiven Leitstellenbetrieb überführt werden sollen. Leitbild des Auftrages ist ein Vertrag, in dem die Innovationspartner ihre Kompetenzen und Erfahrungen zusammenführen, um ein völlig neues Einsatzleitsystem auf modernstem informationstechnischem Stand zu entwickeln. Dazu werden vom Auftragnehmer die erforderlichen technischen und fachlichen Fähigkeiten im Bereich der zukunftsweisender Softwareentwicklung erwartet, während der ZRF langjährige praktische Erfahrungen im Leitstellenbetrieb, einen realen Rahmen für die praktische Erprobung und ein klar definiertes aus der Praxis entwickeltes Anforderungsprofil für ein innovatives Einsatzleitsystem einbringt. Ziel der Innovationspartnerschaft ist die Entwicklung eines marktgängigen Produktes, das dem Auftragnehmer die weitere Verwertung ermöglicht und dem ZRF einen wirtschaftlich vorteilhaften Erwerb der gemeinsam entwickelten Lösung ermöglicht.

title: Luxembourg – Economic impact assessment – EBS Regulation (2019/2152) impact assessment support
description: European business statistics (EBS) provide a wide range of information on businesses operating in the EU’s industry, trade, construction and service sectors, as well as their global interactions. The fast-changing social, technological and economic environment and related globalisation (and regionalisation) as well as competitiveness challenges and opportunities have however shown the need for responding in timelier manner to new user needs supporting policy action. The call to reduce the administrative burden on businesses requires an assessment of the sources and methods used for compiling EBS to ensure that the impact on the businesses is as limited as possible. To this end, the Commission launched the evaluation of the EBS Regulation (2019/2152), which is the first formal step in the review process. The impact assessment is the next important step in the review, in line with the Better Regulation requirements. The current call is aiming at contracting services supporting the Commission in performing the impact assessment of a potential amendment to the EBS Regulation. The tasks cover: problem definition; drivers, objectives, and policy options definition; cost and benefits identification and assessment; stakeholders’ consultations definition and implementation; collection, analyses and reporting on information required for drawing conclusions on the policy options; reporting on the results of the assessment, drawing conclusions and development of monitoring KPIs for the preferred policy option; support throughout the adoption process. The tasks and deliverables under this contract would support the Commission in drawing conclusions and deciding on the policy options concerning a potential amendment of the EBS Regulation, as well as on drafting the Commission Staff Working Document accompanying a potential proposal for amendment to the EBS Regulation.

buyer: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
title: Germany – Administration, defence and social security services – 10013893-Expert Pool Social Protection and Disability Inclusion of Refugees and Host Communities in Jordan
description: The project "Social Protection and Inclusion for Refugees and Host Communities in Jordan" (SPIRIT), is funded by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH (November 2025 - October 2028). SPIRIT"s objective is to improve access to high-quality social protection services in Jordan for refugees and members of host communities with disabilities and their families, respectively. The main political partner of the SPIRIT project is the Ministry of Social Development (MoSD) of Jordan; the Higher Council for Persons with Disabilities (HCD) of Jordan is a key implementing partner. The key target group of the project are refugees with disabilities and members of host communities with disabilities and their families in Jordan, respectively. Mediators are social workers and MoSD personnel at the local level as well as technical staff and managers of the MoSD, the HCD and Organizations of Persons with Disabilities (OPDs). The project will work on four output areas. Output 1 aims to improve procedural requirements for the recognition of disabilities for both refugees and members of host communities. This includes supporting a test phase of the reformed procedure as well as its digital integration. The aim of Output 2 is to strengthen physical and digital referral mechanisms for people with disabilities. This includes the training of relevant staff in the application of standardised referral mechanisms as well as the provision of disability-specific services. Output 3 aims to strengthen decentralised MoSD institutions in Amman Governorate so that they can independently and systematically offer social services to support a self-determined life for people with disabilities and their relatives; particular attention is given to the needs of women and girls. Output 4 aims to provide relevant decision-makers with evidence-based guidance for the expansion of needs-based social protection services for refugees and Jordanians with disabilities; these recommendations are meant to adopted through national consultations and involving self-advocacy organisations. The project follows a multi-level approach. It aims to strengthen the institutional capacities of state agencies to provide social protection services for people with disabilities (organisational level) and to expand the individual skills of their employees (individual level). In the sense of an integrated approach, refugees and Jordanians are addressed equally. A gender-responsive design ensures that the needs of women and girls with disabilities are consistently taken into account and that family caregivers, mainly women and girls, are given targeted support.

buyer: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
title: Germany – Business development consultancy services – 10013553-Pool of experts for implementation of inclusive Contract Farming (iCF) schemes
description: The BMZ commissioned project "Strengthening Rural Value Chains" has received a co-financing from the Gates Foundation to develop a robust, competitive and inclusive horticulture sector in Ethiopia, Kenya and Uganda, in alignment with the implementation of the Ethiopia National Horticulture Strategy (ENHS) and the CEHA National Chapters in Kenya and Uganda. By strengthening fruit and vegetable value chains (in particular avocado, onion and potato), the project seeks to drive sustainable job creation, income growth, improved nutrition, and enhanced regional trade integration across the COMESA and EAC regions. The primary target group consists of small-scale producers (SSPs), with particular emphasis on women and youth aged 18-35, as well as agribusinesses engaged in production, aggregation, value addition, exports, and domestic market supply. The project focuses on enterprises with strong growth potential in structured domestic, regional, and international markets, while addressing systemic constraints faced by women and youth, including limited access to finance, technical skills, productive resources, and market opportunities. In addition, the project works closely with producer organizations, cooperatives, industry associations, and private-sector service providers in areas such as finance, insurance, climate-resilient inputs, innovation, and sustainable farming solutions. The project is built around two complementary intervention areas. The first focuses on strengthening inclusive business models through inclusive Contract Farming (iCF) schemes and investor readiness support. Small-scale producers will be professionalized and integrated into sustainable markets through partnerships with aggregators, exporters, and other off takers. The project promotes improved access to quality inputs, advisory services, finance, and reliable markets, while supporting contracting enterprises to strengthen governance systems, operational efficiencies, and internal controls. Depending on the maturity of the enterprise, investor readiness support may include business model strengthening, financial management improvements, governance support, and access-to-finance facilitation. This approach enables agribusinesses to become more creditworthy, scalable, and resilient, while simultaneously improving market access and income opportunities for SSPs. The project also supports the development of domestic, regional, and export markets to diversify market opportunities and reduce vulnerability to market shocks. The second intervention area focuses on strengthening key market institutions and the enabling environment for the horticulture sector. The project supports the implementation capacities of the ENHS and the CEHA National Chapters in Kenya and Uganda, as well as their member associations. Horticulture sector associations will be strengthened to improve governance, service delivery, market information provision, collective marketing, and advocacy for conducive policy and regulatory frameworks. Enhanced institutional capacity will enable these organizations to better represent sector interests, influence policy reforms, and provide more effective services to their members. Addressing constraints simultaneously at micro, meso, and macro levels will improve sector competitiveness and create sustainable economic opportunities. By combining inclusive contract farming, investor readiness, market systems development, and institutional strengthening, the project is expected to increase the integration of small-scale producers into formal markets, improve access to finance and services for agribusinesses, strengthen sector coordination, and enhance the resilience and competitiveness of the horticulture sector.

description: Die Freihafenelbbrücke (FHEB) wurde durch einen Schiffsanprall am 28.10.2025 beschädigt. Nachfolgende Untersuchungen und Überprüfungen der HPA haben ergeben, dass die Brücke nicht vor Ort reparabel ist, nicht mehr verkehrssicher genutzt werden kann und das Mittelteil schnellstmöglich ausgebaut werden muss. Die Straße inkl. Fuß- und Radweg und die mittlere Schiffsdurchfahrt sind gesperrt. Zudem soll die Trasse der FHEB der Deutschen Bahn für die Erneuerung der Bahnbrücken als Umfahrungsstrecke zur Verfügung gestellt werden. Im selben Zeitraum wurde bei Untersuchungen an verschiedenen Bauwerken in der Trasse Neue Elbbrücken (B4/B75) festgestellt, dass diese Bauwerke in einem schlechteren Zustand sind, als bisherige Prüfungen erwarten ließen. Dies führt dazu, dass in den kommenden Jahren immer wieder mit unterschiedlichen, erheblichen Einschränkungen an den Bauwerken dieser Trasse für Reparatur- und Ertüchtigungsarbeiten zu rechnen ist. Die zeitliche Überlagerung mit den Folgen der Schiffshavarie und die zu beobachtenden verkehrlichen Auswirkungen erzeugen eine besondere zeitliche Dringlichkeit für eine Abhilfe. Um Abhilfe zu schaffen ist geplant, einen Brückenzug unmittelbar westlich der Neuen Elbbrücken errichten. Der Brückenzug verläuft unmittelbar westlich der Trasse Neue Elbbrücken und dient als Ersatztrasse für den Straßen- und Fuß-/Radwegverkehr im Bereich der Norderelbquerung.

Klimazuschlag, Schwemmholz, Verklausung) und Erstellung eines Schutzbautenkatasters (SBK) für das Einzugsgebiet. * Risikodialog gemäss PLANAT und Fachordner Wasserbau zur Abstimmung mit Behörden, Betroffenen und Fachstellen. * Variantenstudium für Hochwasserschutzmassnahmen unter Berücksichtigung von Fischgängigkeit, ökologischer Aufwertung, ISOS/Ortsbildschutz und Stauanlagengesetzgebung (Geschiebesammler). * Erarbeitung eines genehmigungsfähigen Wasserbauplans (SIA-Phasen 22–33) mit Option zur Verlängerung für Ausschreibung, Ausführung und Inbetriebnahme (SIA-Phasen 41–53). Projektperimeter: Einzugsgebiet des Riderbachs (3.8 km²) von den Bogensperren 14/15 bis zur Mündung in den Thunersee, inkl. Geschiebesammler, Gerinneabschnitte und Siedlungsbereich.

title: Germany – Architectural and related services – Alte Metzgerei jetzt WOHNEN Bad Kötzing - Planungsleistungen nach § 34 Gebäude und Innenräume HOAI 2021
description: Gegenstand des Projekts ist die Sanierung und Umnutzung des sogenannten Schoiereranwesens („Alte Metzgerei“) in zentraler Lage der Bad Kötztinger Altstadt, unmittelbar neben dem Rathaus. Der Umbau der alten Metzgerei in Bad Kötzting ist eines der fünf Pilotprojekte des Modellvorhabens „Leerstand jetzt WOHNEN“ des Bayerischen Staatsministeriums für Wohnen, Bau und Verkehr im experimentellen Wohnungsbau und der Städtebauförderung.“ Weitere Informationen zum Modellvorhaben finden Sie unter: www.leerstand-jetzt-wohnen.de Das historisch gewachsene, nicht denkmalgeschützte Gebäudeensemble weist Bauteile aus dem 15./16. Jahrhundert sowie zahlreiche spätere Umbauten auf. Ziel des Modellvorhabens ist die weitgehende Erhaltung, die einfache und kostengünstige Weiterentwicklung des Bestands zu bezahlbarem Wohnraum mit ergänzenden öffentlichen, gemeinschaftlichen und gewerblichen Nutzungen. Vorgesehen sind flexible Nutzungsbereiche im Erdgeschoss sowie innovative Wohnungen in den Obergeschossen. Ein begrünter Lichthof mit neuer Treppen- und Galerieerschließung, Gemeinschaftsräume, ein Dachgarten und Lagerflächen ergänzen das Nutzungskonzept. Die Planung soll die unterschiedlichen historischen Zeitschichten sichtbar erhalten und mit wirtschaftlichen, einfachen und langlebigen Lösungen zu einem zeitgemäßen Gesamtgebäude weiterentwickeln. Die als Anlage zur Verfügung gestellte Machbarkeitsstudie ist Grundlage für die Bearbeitung, vor allem für die Analyse, soll aber hinterfragt und weiterentwickelt werden.

description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) / MARKET INTELLIGENCE NOTICE Notice: This is a Request for Information (RFI) for market intelligence and for informational purposes only. This announcement does not constitute a Solicitation or a Request for Proposal (RFP), and no solicitation is currently available. Participation in this RFI is strictly voluntary. The Government will not be obligated to award any agreement or contract because of this RFI, nor will it reimburse respondents for any costs associated with the preparation or submission of information. Submitting a response will not affect a firm�s ability to submit a proposal should a formal solicitation be issued in the future. NAICS Code: 236220 � Commercial and Institutional Building Construction (Note: While Other Transaction Authority is not subject to FAR-based small business regulations, this NAICS code is provided for market research to help the Government understand the size and demographics of the interested industrial base.) Small Business Size Standard: $45 Million PROJECT OVERVIEW The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Alaska District, has a requirement for Construct a modified standard design permanent party dining facility consistent with the Campus Style Dining Venue. Project includes food preparation and cooking areas, entrance/control area, serving, dining, dishwashing, pot wash, administration, locker area, waste disposal, receiving and loading dock, cold and dry storage, information systems, fire protection and alarm systems, Intrusion Detection System (IDS) installation, and Energy Monitoring Control Systems (EMCS) connection. Sustainability and energy enhancement measures are included. Supporting facilities include site development, utilities and connections, lighting, paving, parking, walks, curbs and gutters, storm drainage, information systems, landscaping and signage. Estimated Acquisition Magnitude: Between $100,000,000-$200,000,000. Planned Acquisition Strategy: Anticipated to utilize Progressive Design Build via Other Transaction Authority (OTA) The Alaska District is conducting market intelligence to assess industry capability and interest in supporting this effort utilizing an Other Transaction (OT) Agreement under the authority of 10 U.S.C. � 2808a, Facility Construction or Repair: Transactions Other Than Contracts and Grants. This authority is distinct from the Department of Defense prototype OT authorities commonly associated with 10 U.S.C. � 4021 and 4022. This authority is intended for military construction projects that involve testing and experimentation associated with new and emergent construction technologies to achieve potential benefits such as enhanced mission resilience, improved installation support, or cost and schedule reduction. The anticipated delivery method is Progressive Design Build. Phase 1: Design and Pre-Construction Services - The OT Awardee shall assist the Government collaboratively in achieving its goals with respect to the project�s scope, constructability, budget, quality, schedule, and in coordination with the Designer of Record (DOR). Phase 2: Final Design and Construction - Upon reaching an agreed-upon level of design (e.g., 95 to 100%), the Awardee will propose a Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP). If the GMP is accepted, the Government will exercise construction execution. If a GMP cannot be agreed upon, the Government retains an "off-ramp" to complete the construct the facility via alternative methods. title: Dedicated Commercial ISP Circuit Installation and Service - Hill AFB
description: 1.0 DESCRIPTION OF REQUIREMENT The Department of the Air Force at Hill Air Force Base (AFB), Utah, intends to award a firm-fixed-price sole-source contract to Lumen Technologies for a dedicated commercial Internet Service Provider (ISP) connection. This circuit is required to support standard government operations and must be independent of existing installation infrastructure. The requirement mandates a dedicated, low-latency fiber optic connection with an expedited installation and operational timeline. The Government anticipates a contract award date in October 2026. The anticipated Period of Performance is one (1) Base Year plus four (4) Option Years. 2.0 STATUTORY AUTHORITY & RATIONALE The proposed contract action is for services for which the Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source under the authority of FAR 6.302-1, Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. Extensive market research, including a previously posted Sources Sought Synopsis and coordination with Base Civil Engineering, determined that Lumen holds exclusive physical access to the required telecommunications infrastructure and termination points on Hill AFB. Justification for Sole Source and Technical Rationale: Physical Infrastructure Constraints: Base Civil Engineering confirmed that non-incumbent vendors lack physical access to the existing base infrastructure. To provide this service, an alternate vendor would be required to construct new, independent physical lines external to the installation and physically interconnect with the incumbent's proprietary infrastructure to enter the base. Schedule Feasibility: The requirement demands an expedited operational timeline. During market research, non-incumbent vendors indicated that establishing the necessary external infrastructure connections would require significantly longer lead times than the Government's mandatory schedule permits. Currently, utilizing the incumbent's existing infrastructure is the only identified method capable of meeting the Government's required delivery timeframe. Network Accountability: Utilizing an alternative vendor would mandate a fragmented infrastructure arrangement, introducing unacceptable Service Level Agreement (SLA) performance risks and potential delays in outage resolution for government operations. 3.0 SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS FOR INTERESTED PARTIES This Notice of Intent is not a request for competitive proposals. A solicitation will not be issued. However, the Government will consider all capability statements, proposals, or quotes received within fifteen (15) days after the date of publication of this synopsis. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement in the future. Firms that believe they can provide the required services in full compliance with the physical infrastructure and expedited timeline requirements must submit a detailed technical capability statement. Responses must explicitly detail how the vendor will achieve on-base termination within the required timeframe without relying on the incumbent's infrastructure. Submit Responses To: Contract Specialist: Angel McKenzie at angel.mckenzie.2@us.af.mil Contracting Officer: Melissa Kennedy at melissa.kennedy.7@us.af.mil Email Subject Line: Capability Statement: Sole Source Notice - Dedicated ISP Hill AFB

description: Notice of Intent to Sole Source NAVSUP Fleet Logistics San Diego (FLCSD) intents to award a Sole Source contract to Conflict Kinetics Corporation, 1893 Preston White Drive, Reston, VA 20191 in accordance with RFO 12.001 and RFO 6.103-1. This requirement to establish a Weapons Synthetic Training System (WSTS) that enables sailors to develop proficiency in small arms weapons handling and employment while in port major fleet concentration areas of San Diego, CA. The WSTS must support sustainment training and certification for armed watch standers on the following weapons: M18 pistol, Rifle (5.56mm), light, and heavy machine guns (7.62mm & .50 Cal). The WSTS will significantly reduce cost of conducting training and certification through significant reduction in expenditure of live ammunition. The WSTS will be capable of quickly rolling out new fleet-wide standardization (e.g., CAT III) or enhancement in training capabilities without the risk of resources or capability constraints that may be present for each location. The proposed contract action is Sole Source only. This Notice of Intent is not a request for competitive quotes or proposals. No solicitation or RFQ will be forthcoming. description: Sources Sought / Request for Information (RFI) Notice Type: Sources Sought Title: Maintenance Service Support for Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) Spectrometers NAICS Code: 334516 Response Due Date: 27 August 2026 at 4:00 pm Pacific Time 1.0 PURPOSE This is a Sources Sought Notice / Request for Information (RFI) only. This notice is issued solely for market research and planning purposes to determine the availability and capability of qualified Small Business sources. This does NOT constitute a Request for Quote (RFQ) or a promise to issue an RFQ in the future. The Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice. 2.0 BACKGROUND & REQUIREMENT The Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) at Edwards AFB, CA, has a requirement for comprehensive preventative and corrective maintenance service support for three (3) Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) Spectrometers: Two (2) Bruker Avance III DFAS systems One (1) Bruker Avance NEO system The contractor shall provide all labor, materials, parts, travel, and software updates required to ensure the equipment operates in accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) specifications. Maintenance must include annual preventative maintenance, telephone support, 24-hour response times for remedial maintenance, and the supply of OEM-equivalent replacement parts. (See attached draft Statement of Work for full details). 3.0 REQUESTED INFORMATION (CAPABILITY STATEMENT) Interested Small Business vendors are requested to submit a Capability Statement (no more than 3-5 pages) addressing their ability to perform the requirements in the draft SOW. Responses must include the following: Company Information: Company Name, CAGE Code, Unique Entity ID (UEI), Point of Contact name, phone number, and email address. Business Size & Status: Indicate your socioeconomic status under the specified NAICS code (e.g., Total Small Business, SDVOSB, WOSB, 8(a), HUBZone). Technical Capability: Provide a brief description of your company�s experience maintaining Bruker Avance III and Avance NEO systems. Confirm your ability to source and install OEM or OEM-equivalent replacement parts. Confirm your authorized access to necessary software diagnostic tools and minor software updates (e.g., series updates like 3.0 to 3.5) required to service these specific systems without voiding manufacturer warranties. Past Performance: List at least one (1) recent (within the last 3 years) contract reference where your company provided similar maintenance services. Include contract number, agency/commercial customer name, and contract value. 4.0 SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS Responses must be submitted electronically via email to the Contracting Officer, Romina Snyder at romina.snyder.2@us.af.mil and Contracting Specialist, Brandy Forbes at brandy.forbes@us.af.mil no later than 27 August 2026 at 4:00 pm PST. title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source - Synthetic Weapons Training System
description: Notice of Intent to Sole Source NAVSUP Fleet Logistics San Diego (FLCSD) intents to award a Sole Source contract to Conflict Kinetics Corporation, 1893 Preston White Drive, Reston, VA 20191 in accordance with RFO 12.001 and RFO 6.103-1. This requirement to establish a Weapons Synthetic Training System (WSTS) that enables sailors to develop proficiency in small arms weapons handling and employment while in port major fleet concentration areas of San Diego, CA. The WSTS must support sustainment training and certification for armed watch standers on the following weapons: M18 pistol, Rifle (5.56mm), light, and heavy machine guns (7.62mm & .50 Cal). The WSTS will significantly reduce cost of conducting training and certification through significant reduction in expenditure of live ammunition. The WSTS will be capable of quickly rolling out new fleet-wide standardization (e.g., CAT III) or enhancement in training capabilities without the risk of resources or capability constraints that may be present for each location. The proposed contract action is Sole Source only. This Notice of Intent is not a request for competitive quotes or proposals. No solicitation or RFQ will be forthcoming. title: Notice of Intent to Award a Sole Source Modification
description: The Naval Information Warfare Systems Command (NAVWAR), in support of the Portfolio Acquisition Executive Mission Systems (PAE MS) ? Capability Portfolio Executive (CPE): Comms, Sensor, Electronic Warfare (EW), and Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) (previously Program Executive Office Command, Control, Communications, Computers and Intelligence (PEO C4I), Communications and Global Positioning System (GPS) Navigation Program Office (PMW/A 170)), intends to award an estimated five (5)-year Period of Performance (PoP) extension to the current five (5) year, sole-source, Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract N00039-22-D-0070 with L3Harris Technologies Incorporated (L3Harris), 1680 University Ave, Rochester, NY 14610, under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1) and Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 6.103-1, as only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. PRP is the overarching solution to provide tactical, portable radios for the Navy (USN), Marine Corps (USMC), Air Force (USAF), Army, Coast Guard, and other Stakeholders. PRP provides portable radios with secure waveform capabilities and critical Satellite Communications (SATCOM) to meet the United States Military Services and Agencies requirements. The proposed contract action will provide for the procurement of various tactical portable radios and related ancillary parts that are used as the principal command and control tools for all Naval Forces including Navy Expeditionary Combat Command (NECC) and Naval Special Warfare (NSW); interoperable with already fielded Joint and Coalition/Allied Forces? radios; and provide portable, shipboard emergency communications. The proposed contract extension will utilize the remaining unused ceiling, which equates to an estimated total value of $2.47 Billion (B). L3Harris is the original designer, developer, and manufacturer of tactical portable radios. As such, L3Harris is the only source capable of continued production of the aforementioned tactical portable radios and related ancillary parts. As the sole provider of tactical portable radios meeting the Form, Fit, and Function (FFF) requirements, L3Harris is the only entity capable of fulfilling tactical portable radio requirements without substantial duplication of cost to the Government that is not expected to be recovered through competition and without creating unacceptable program delays in fulfilling the Government?s requirements. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals. A competitive solicitation will not be posted. However, interested parties may submit information identifying their interest and capability to respond. The Government reserves the sole discretion to determine whether to compete this procurement based on the responses received. Responses should be submitted by email no later than fifteen calendar days from the date of this synopsis to the Contract Specialist at blake.a.erickson3.civ@us.navy.mil with courtesy copy to the Contracting Officer at kenneth.b.nickel2.civ@us.navy.mil. Verbal questions will NOT be accepted. Questions will be answered by posting answers to the SAM.gov website; accordingly, questions shall NOT contain proprietary or classified information.

title: Netherlands – Landscaping work – 1-W-0020605-25 Realiseren Hofbogenpark
description: Het uitvoeren van dakdekkerswerkzaamheden en het aanleggen van een park, met verlichting, watersysteem, liften, trappen, meubilair op het bestaande dak van de Hofbogen voor het realiseren van het Hofbogenpark in de wijken Agniesebuurt, Bergpolder en Liskwartier in de gemeente Rotterdam. Het verloop van het project is te onderscheiden in drie (3) verschillende projectonderdelen die allen integraal behoren bij deze opdrachten. - I. Werkvoorbereiding; - II. Realisatie; - III. Onderhoud onderdelen (driejarig (met mogelijke verlenging van nog twee keer een jaar)). Het werk bestaat in hoofdzaak uit: ▪ Verwijderen van de huidige dakbedekking, ca 12.500 m2. ▪ Verwijderen van de bovenste (beton) druklaag en het herstellen van de betonnen constructieve onderlaag, inclusief herstellen en behandelen van gecorrodeerde wapening waar nodig ca. 12.500m2 ▪ Aanbrengen van een nieuwe waterkerende laag, ca 14.500 m2. ▪ Aanbrengen van een dakpark welke grofweg is opgebouwd uit een krattensysteem ten behoeve van het watersysteem, substraten, aankleding van het park (beplanting, pad in halfverharding, vijvers, meubilair), ca 12.500 m2. ▪ Aanbrengen van een Urban Water Buffer, ca 1 stuks. ▪ Vervangen van de bestaande balustrade aan weerszijde, ca 3.500m. ▪ Opknappen van het onderhoudspad aan beide zijden, ca 3.500m. ▪ Realiseren en aanbrengen van de parkloge. ▪ Aanbrengen van stijgpunten (stalen trappen en liften) verdeeld over de totale lengte van het park, ca. 9 stuks. ▪ Het (kleinschalig) aanpassen van het maaiveld waar de stijgpunten aanlanden inclusief funderingen, ca. 1.350 m2 en ca. 50 stuks heipalen. ▪ Alle werkzaamheden dienen uitgevoerd te worden aan een object wat gedurende de werkzaamheden in gebruik is en in binnenstedelijk gebied staat. ▪ Onderhoud van het gerealiseerde. De bovenstaande opsomming van werkzaamheden en hoeveelheden zijn slechts een indicatie van de te verrichten werkzaamheden en alleen bedoeld om de interesse van potentiële Inschrijvers voor de onderhavige Opdracht te wekken. Inschrijvers kunnen geen rechten ontlenen aan deze opsomming. Zie voor een nadere technische omschrijving van de uit te voeren werkzaamheden het RAW-bestek en de STABU onderdelen.

title: Finland – Construction work – Jämsän sosiaali- ja terveyskeskus, KVR-urakka
description: Keski-Suomen hyvinvointialue laati sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden palveluverkkosuunnitelmat PV1 ja PV2, jotka Aluevaltuusto on hyväksynyt. Palveluverkkojen perusteella Keksi-Suomen alueella on jatkossa kolme alueellista sosiaali- ja terveyskeskusta, joista yksi on Jämsään sijoittuva uusi sosiaali- ja terveyskeskus. Hanke toteutetaan uudisrakennushankkeena osoitteeseen Keskuskatu, Jämsä. Tarjouspyynnön liitteenä on kuvaus hankkeesta. Tilaaja on laatinut hankkeesta hankesuunnitelman liitteineen tehtyjen palveluverkkopäätösten perustella. Hankesuunnitteluvaiheen jälkeen lähinnä arkkitehtisuunnitelmia on kehitetty viitesuunnitelmiksi. Viitesuunnitelmat on merkitty asiakirjaluetteloon. Urakkamuotona käytetään KVR-urakkaa, jossa hankkeen päätoteuttaja vastaa myös hankesuunnitteluvaiheen jälkeisestä suunnittelusta. Tilaajan erillishankintoina on urakkarajaliitteen sekä huonekorttien mukaisesti osa käyttäjien toimintaan liittyvistä koneista, laitteista ja järjestelmistä. Aluevaltuuston 9.12.2025 tekemästä vuoden 2026 talousarviosta ja toisen vaiheen palveluverkosta on tehty aluevalituksia. Päätökset sisälsivät myös Jämsän sosiaali- ja terveyskeskuksen. Hämeenlinnan hallinto-oikeus myönsi päätöksille täytäntöönpanoluvan. Keski-Suomen hyvinvointialue on saanut hankkeelle valtiovarainministeriöltä myönteisen, mutta ehdollisen päätöksen lainanottovaltuudesta. Lainanottovaltuus perustuu aluevaltuuston hyväksymään vuoden 2026 hyväksymään investointiohjelmaan. Lainanottovaltuudelle on asetettu ehtoja, jotka liittyvät investointien välttämättömyyteen ja lainanhoitokyvyn valmistamiseen. Ehtona lainanottovaltuuden käytölle on se, että aluevaltuusto sitoutuu arviointimenettelyssä valmistuneen toimenpideohjelman taloudellisten tavoitteiden noudattamiseen. Mikäli hankkeen kustannukset ylittävät urakkatarjouslaskennan jälkeen hankkeelle varatun budjetin, hanketta ei voi aloittaa. Tilaaja ei maksa tarjousten jättäjille korvausta tarjouslaskennasta.

title: Finland – Software package and information systems – Identiteetin- ja käyttövaltuushallinnan järjestelmän hankinta
description: Länsi‑Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue ja Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialueet (myöhemmin myös Tilaaja) pyytävät tarjouksia identiteetin‑ ja käyttövaltuushallinnan järjestelmästä (IAM‑järjestelmä). Hankintayksikkönä toimivat Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue sekä Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialue. Yhteistyö hankinnassa mahdollistaa paremmat resurssit kilpailutuksen toteuttamiseen. Lisäksi yhteistyön toivotaan tuovan lisää mielenkiintoa järjestelmätoimittajille kilpailutukseen. Myös hyvinvointialueita ohjaavien ministeriöiden tahtotila on YTA-alueen sisäinen yhteistyö järjestelmähankinnoissa. Muun ohella edellä mainituista syistä hyvinvointialueet ovat päättäneet hankintalain 21 §:n mukaisen hankintayhteistyön muodostamisesta. Hyvinvointialueet toteuttavat kilpailutuksen yhteistyössä ja alueet ovat muodostaneet hankintaa varten hankintarenkaan. Hankinnan tavoitteena on hankkia identiteetin‑ ja käyttövaltuushallinnan järjestelmä (IAM), joka vastaa kyvykkyyksiltään, toiminnallisuuksiltaan, laajuudeltaan ja palvelutasoltaan tilaajien nykytilan ja tulevaisuuden tarpeisiin. Hankittavan IAM‑ratkaisun käyttöönoton myötä tarkoituksena on korvata ja keskittää identiteettien ja käyttöoikeuksien hallintaan liittyviä nykyisiä, osin hajautettuja toimintamalleja ja järjestelmäratkaisuja yhteen hallittuun kokonaisuuteen. Hankinnassa tavoitellaan nimenomaisesti identiteetin‑ ja käyttövaltuushallinnan tarpeisiin tarkoitettua, vakiintunutta valmisohjelmistoon perustuvaa, ohjelmistopalveluna (SaaS) toteutettua IAM‑ratkaisua, joka tukee käyttöoikeusprosessien automaatiota, toimintavarmuutta, jatkuvaa kehittymistä ja kustannustehokasta toimintaa. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan sisällöstä on tarjouspyynnön liitteillä 2A "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus - LUVN" ja 2B. "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus - VAKE". Hankinnassa haetaan yhtä (1) päävastuullista toimittajaa, joka vastaa kokonaisratkaisusta ja siihen liittyvistä palveluista.

title: Finland – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Ilolan koulun peruskorjaus- ja korvaavan uudisrakennushankkeen pää- ja arkkitehtisuunnittelun hankinta
description: Vantaan kaupungin Toimitilajohtaminen pyytää tarjousta Ilolan koulun peruskorjaus- ja korvaavan uudisrakennushankkeen pää- ja arkkitehtisuunnittelusta lähtien hankesuunnitelmasta, sisältäen piha- ja liikennemerkkisuunnittelun sekä sisustus-, ammattikeittiö-, akustinen- ja paloturvallisuussuunnittelun tarjouspyynnössä ja liitteissä tarkemmin määritellyllä tavalla. Kaupunginosa: 71 Ilola Osoite: Epinkoskentie 5, 01390 Vantaa Kortteli/tontti: 71079 Kiinteistö: 92-071-0079-006 Rakennus: 101790778F Rakennusvuosi: 1987 Laajennusvuosi: 1993 Kerrosluku: 1 (+ 2 pientä parvia) Ilolan koulun rakennus 1 on valmistunut vuonna 1987 ja rakennus 2 on valmistunut vuonna 1993. Rakennukset ovat 1-kerroksisia, ja ne on yhdistetty toisiinsa yhdyskäytävällä. Kiinteistössä on myös vuonna 2014 valmistettu rakennus, joka ei kuuluu tähän hankkeeseen, paitsi 2 pientä tilamuutosta. Hankkeessa kuuluu myös pihan peruskorjausta, korjattavan pihan laajuus on merkitty liitteessä 5c. Nykyinen Ilolan koulu on talotekniikan osalta osin huonossa ja osin tyydyttävässä kunnossa. Pintamateriaalit ovat pääosin alkuperäisiä, vuodelta 1987 ja 1993 ja uusimisen tarpeessa. Vanhimman rakennuksen korjausaste on todettu liian korkeaksi korjaukseen. Sen lisäksi, tilat ovat eritasoilla ja suunniteltu aikaisempaan, poikkeukselliseen pedagogiseen suun-nitelmaan; tilat sopivat huonosti nykyiseen pedagogikaan. Tarveselvityksessä laadittiin Ilolan 1987–1993 rakennettujen koulurakennusten korjaus- ja tilamuutostarpeita sekä vanhimpiin osiin uudiskorvaavarakennus, jotta tilat palvelevat käyttäjien tämänhetkisiä ja tu-levaisuuden toiminnallisia vaatimuksia ja tarpeita. Koulu on osittain korjattu vuosina 2018–2023. Peruskorjauksen yhteydessä toteutetaan tilamuutokset, jotka parantavat koulun toiminnallisuutta, turvallisuutta ja esteettömyyttä. Tilamuutokset liittyvät myös opetustoimen toimintakulttuurin muutokseen ja uuteen opetussuunnitelmaan. Tiettyjen osien teknisen iän päätyessä, toiminallisien parannuksien ja uuden pedagogisen suunnitelman vuoksi, kouluun päätettiin tehdä laajat muutos- ja korjaustyöt. Tehtävien parannuksien laajuus on arvioitava tarkemmin hankesuunnittelun yhteydessä, jolloin kuntoarviot, -tutkimukset ja -selvitykset on päivitettävä ajan tasalle. Ilolan koulun hankkeen hankesuunnitelma alkaa syyskuussa 2026. Rakentaminen on suunniteltu aloitettavaksi syksyllä 2027 ja valmistuvaksi vuoden 2028 lopulla. Rakentamisen aikana koulu siirtyy Kytöpuisto koulun väistöpaviljonkiin. Laajuustiedot (noin): Peruskorjattava rakennus 1714 brm2, 1516 htm2, 1305 hym2 Uudiskorvaava rakennus: 2180 brm2, 1585 htm2, 1440 hym2 Yhteensä: 3894 brm2, 3101 htm2, 2745 hym2 Tontin pinta-ala 27 804 m2, josta noin 9770 m2 kuuluu hankkeeseen.

title: Finland – Autoclaves – A202345 Ruokaviraston autoklaavien uusinta
description: Senaatti-kiinteistöt kilpailuttaa autoklaavien uusinnan Ruokaviraston tiloihin. Ruokaviraston tiloissa sijaitsevat autoklaavit ovat teknisesti elinkaarensa päässä, jonka vuoksi Senaatti-kiinteistöt on tehnyt alustavan päätöksen, jossa ensimmäisessä vaiheessa 7 kpl Ruokaviraston autoklaavia uusitaan. Virastossa halutaan varmistaa laboratoriotilojen huoltovarmuus ajantasaistamalla autoklaavit ja niiden toiminnallisuus. BSL-3 laboratorioissa tehtävää toimintaa ei voi keskeyttää ja väistötilat ovat hankalia järjestää, joten autoklaavien vaihdon yhteydessä tulee ottaa huomioon muut mahdolliset seisokin aikana haluttavat toimenpiteet tiloissa ja laitevaihtojen suunnittelu ja toteutus tulee tehdä tiiviissä yhteistyössä tilaajien kanssa. Autoklaaveja on kahta päätyyppiä. Turvalaboratorioiden (BSL3) autoklaavit ovat niin kutsuttuja tuhoautoklaaveja, joilla käsitellään ja tuhotaan laboratoriossa syntyvät bioturvallisuuden kannalta vaaralliset jätteet. Tavanomaisemmilla laboratorioautoklaaveilla steriloidaan välineitä sekä valmistetaan elatusaineita laboratorion käyttöön. Autoklaavit uusitaan peruskorjauksena oleville paikoille olevien taloteknisten liittymien sallimilla kapasiteeteilla. Hankinnassa tilaajaosapuolina toimivat Senaatti-kiinteistöt sekä Ruokavirasto. Senaatti-kiinteistöt vastaa sekä allekirjoittaa Autoklaavien hankintasopimuksen. Ruokavirasto vastaa sekä allekirjoittaa Autoklaavien takuuajan jälkeisen määräaikaishuoltosopimuksen. Autoklaavien uusinta toteutetaan siten, että laitevaihdon uusimisen aiheuttama käyttökatkoaika on mahdollisimman lyhyt. Laitekohtainen alustava asennusaika autoklaaveille on ilmoitettu tarjouspyynnön liitteessä, jonka nimi sisältää BEM-version päivämäärän "A202345 Alustava aikataulu 10.6.2026" Tilaaja järjestää tarjoajaehdokkaille tilojen esittelytilaisuuden kahtena eri ajankohtana. Esittelytilaisuus pidetään Helsingissä osoitteessa: Mustialankatu 3, 00790 Helsinki. - Ensimmäinen esittelypäivä on keskiviikko 1.7.2026 klo 9-11 tai 12.30-14.30. Ilmoittautuminen esittelytilaisuuteen to 29.6.2026 klo 14:00 mennessä. - Toinen esittelypäivä on maanantai 10.8.2026 klo 9-11 tai 13-15. Ilmoittautuminen esittelytilaisuuteen to 6.8.2026 klo 14:00 mennessä. Ilmoittautuminen tulee tehdä sähköpostiosoitteeseen: anna.martemaa@senaatti.fi. Ilmoittautumisen sähköpostiotsikko ”Ilmoittautuminen Ruokaviraston tilojen näyttöön”. Viestikenttään vähintään seuraavat tiedot: Yrityksen nimi, osallistujien nimet ja tittelit, syntymäaika, puhelinnumero sekä päivämäärä jolloin tilaisuuteen osallistuu ja kellon aika. Esittelytilaisuuteen osallistuvalta edellytetään vaitiolositoumuksen allekirjoittamista tilaisuudessa. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvioitu arvo on noin 2 450 000 €

title: Norway – Printed matter and related products – ID card for access and login to the health authorities in Helse Vest
description: The objective of the procurement is to procure smartcards that shall function as a common platform for both physical access and digital authentication and shall therefore be delivered in accordance with Annex 2 the Contracting Authority ́s requirement specifications. The customer intends to implement a transition to new card technology in the region at the start of the agreement period for the roll-out of the new logon system. The stated scope and value is therefore an estimate for information to the tenderer, and it is subject to both an increase and reduction in volume for the different card types offered throughout the contract period. The estimated volume per annum is in Annex 1 Price Form. The ID card shall be used in the health service and it shall be suitable for: • Secure identification of employees • Physical access control • Strong, passwordless authentication to IT systems • Use Buypass ID for authentication and signing in different external applications. • Use with additional equipment such as, for example, electronic key cabinets, laundry machines, etc. The card shall support the health sector ́s requirements for safety, availability, hygiene and operational security. Furthermore, the contract shall take into account new areas of use, technologies and security requirements so that this can be used during the contract period, without the need for a new competition, as far as this is compatible with the procurement regulations. The contracting authority shall, therefore, be able to use new generations of card technology in the contract period. See the Requirement Specifications and the Price Form for further details. The contracting authority draws attention to the market that a framework agreement for ID cards for older card versions has already been established for older card versions, which will be used parallel in this transition period. Call-offs on the new contract will therefore occur as part of a stage-by-stage phasing out of older card technology in the current framework agreement.

Kunnossapitotyöt sisältävät 110 kV:n jännitetasoisen ilmajohtorakenteisen sähkönsiirtoverkon sekä 110kV:n jännitetasoisen maakaapeliverkon töitä. 110 kV:n kunnossapitotöihin sisältyvät maadoituksien korjaukset, kävelytarkastus, lahotarkastukset sekä maadoitusmittaukset ja maapotentiaaliraportti. Hankintaan sisältyvät myös 110 kV:n ilmajohtoverkon viankorjaukset, huurrekuormien pudotus ja viankorjauksen materiaalivaraston ylläpito. Toimittajalla täytyy olla kyky henkilöstön, kaluston ja osaamisen puolesta toteuttaa 110 kV avojohtoverkon viankorjauksia sekä hoitaa työkohteen maadoittaminen. Sähköasemien 110 kV jännitetason komponentit eivät kuulu tähän urakkaan, sähköasemakentällä sijaitsevia 110kV maakaapeliverkon komponentteja ja voimajohtopylväitä lukuun ottamatta. Hankinnan sisältöä on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteessä "JSE 110 kV kunnossapidon hankekuvaus 2027-2031". Hankinnan määräaikainen sopimusjakso on 1.1.2027 - 31.12.2027. Määräaikaisen sopimusjakson jälkeen tilaaja voi halutessaan jatkaa sopimusta jatko-optioilla: 1.1.2028 - 31.12.2029 ja 1.1.2030 - 31.12.2031. title: Denmark – Refuse disposal and treatment – Modtagelse af jord til kartering
description: Favrskov Affald A/S udbyder modtagelse af jord til kartering. Jorden til kartering vil komme fra firegenbrugspladser i Favrskov Affalds A/S’ forsyningsområde. Jorden er opgravet fra private haver ogarealer i Favrskov Kommune. Jorden vil typisk være tør og skovlbar, men enkelte, mindre partier kanvære ikke-skovlbare.Forureningsgraden kendes ikke, men jorden kan forekomme i følgende forureningsklasserne 0/1 –4, hvor mindst 90 % af jorden til kartering vil være klasse 0/1-jord og kun i ekstraordinære tilfældeforurenet.Mængden af afgravet jord forventes at udgøre omkring 5.000 ton/år, men Ordregiver kan ikke garanteresbestemte minimums mængder. Baseret på denne mængde estimerer Ordregiver et årligtforbrug i aftaleperioden på 800.000-900.000 DKK.Tilbudsgiver skal ikke stå for transporten af jorden.Favrskov Affald A/S udbyder herved én samlet rammeaftale om modtagelse af jord til kartering,som tildeles én tilbudsgiver. Rammeaftalen vil være gældende fra underskriftstidspunktet og fire årfrem.

title: Finland – Cleaning and sanitation services – Lohjan Liikuntakeskus Oy:n ja Lohjan Liikuntahallit Oy:n ylläpitosiivouspalvelut
description: Lohjan Liikuntakeskus Oy ja Lohjan Liikuntahallit Oy (myöhemmin Tilaaja) pyytää tarjousta liikuntatilojen ylläpitosiivouspalvelusta. Hankittava puhtauspalvelu käsittää Virkistysuimala Neidonkeitaan, Lohjan jäähallin ja Sporttikeskus Tennarin tilojen ylläpitosiivouspalvelut. Tilaaja vastaa tilojen siivouksen järjestämisestä pääosin omalla henkilöstöllään. Siivouspalvelut toteutetaan hybridimallina, jossa Tilaajan omaa siivoushenkilöstöä täydennetään ulkopuolisella palveluntuottajalla Tilaajan kulloisenkin tarpeen mukaisesti. Tarve vaihtelee riippuen Tilaajan oman siivoushenkilöstön saatavuudesta. Tarve ilmoitetaan kuukausittain viimeistään kaksi viikkoa ennen seuraavan kuukauden alkua. Ulkopuolisen palveluntuottajan arvioitu työmäärä on yhteensä vähintään 50 tuntia viikossa, pois lukien heinäkuu, jolloin palvelun tarve on arviolta vähäisempi. Ilmoitettu tuntimäärä on arvio, eikä Tilaaja sitoudu tiettyyn vähimmäisostomäärään. Hankittava palvelu koskee liikuntapaikkojen ylläpitosiivousta. Palvelu sisältää vaativaa liikuntapaikkojen erikoissiivousta, joka edellyttää palveluntuottajalta osaamista ja kokemusta liikuntapaikkojen siivouksesta. Työtä tehdään sekä arkipäivisin että viikonloppuisin. Palvelu ei sisällä yötyötä. Työt suoritetaan Tilaajan käytössä olevilla siivousvälineillä ja -koneilla. Tilaaja vastaa siivousaineista, tarvikkeista sekä välineiden ja koneiden huollosta. Kilpailutuksen perusteella valitaan etusijajärjestykseen kolme (3) sopimustoimittajaa. Sopimustoimittajat asetetaan etusijajärjestykseen tarjousvertailussa saatujen kokonaispisteiden perusteella. Tilaukset tehdään ensisijaisesti eniten pisteitä saaneelta toimittajalta. Mikäli etusijalla oleva toimittaja ei pysty tuottamaan palvelua Tilaajan tarvitsemassa aikataulussa, Tilaaja voi tilata palvelun etusijajärjestyksessä seuraavalta sopimustoimittajalta. Sopimuskauden pituus on kaksi (2) vuotta 1.10.2026 alkaen. Tilaajalla on mahdollisuus jatkaa sopimusta kahdella (2) yhden (1) vuoden mittaisella optiokaudella. Tilaaja päättää kummankin optiokauden käyttöönotosta erikseen. Puitejärjestelyn hankintojen ennakoitu kokonaisarvo on noin 140.000 euroa (alv 0 %) vuodessa. Kyseessä on arvio, eikä se sido Tilaajaa. Hankinnan vuosittainen ennakoitu arvo jakautuu seuraavasti: Lohjan Liikuntakeskuksen Oy 80.000 euroa (alv 0 %) vuodessa Lohjan Liikuntahallit Oy 60.000 euroa (alv 0 %) vuodessa Puitejärjestelyn enimmäisarvo on 700.000 euroa (alv 0 %).
